description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different consistency conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 8 with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 30 with tick labels at integer values. There are four lines displayed on the plot. A red line, marked with a star, begins at approximately (1, 24.5) and increases to approximately (8, 29.5). A purple dashed line begins at approximately (1, 22) and increases to approximately (8, 27). A blue dashed line begins at approximately (1, 22.5) and increases to approximately (8, 27.5). A magenta solid line begins at approximately (1, 22.5) and increases to approximately (8, 28).
